government.note: Parliamentary republic under the 1992 Constitution. Executive power is vested in the Government led by the Prime Minister, who is nominated by the President and confirmed by the Riigikogu. The President is elected by the Riigikogu with a two-thirds majority (68 of 101) in up to three rounds; failing that, an Electoral Assembly of the Riigikogu members and local-government representatives elects by majority. The President has no executive powers and suspends party membership in office.

system.note: 101 seats by list PR in multi-member districts with compensation seats; 5% national threshold; modified D'Hondt (divisor raised to the power 0.9). Elections on the first Sunday of March every four years. seats_2000 is the result of the March 1999 election; changes in party affiliation between March 1999 and 1 January 2000 were not checked. The Moderates' 17 seats are recorded under est.sde (the Moderate People's Party, formed 29 May 1999).
